texts.t002: Meet Washma Amjad. Discover how a hobby in graphic design became a full-time creative career built around storytelling, editing, and color.
texts.t009: I’m Washma Amjad, a graphic designer and web developer who believes every design has a story worth telling.
texts.t010: Two years ago, I started exploring design for myself. Today, I turn raw ideas into visual stories with intention, emotion, and a reason to keep watching.
texts.t015: A LITTLE CURIOSITY GOES A LONG WAY.
texts.t036: There wasn’t a grand plan at the beginning.
texts.t037: Just a desire to understand why good design works.
texts.t038: I started graphic design two years ago as a hobby, helping myself understand the logic behind a design — the choices that make it feel balanced, clear, and meaningful.
texts.t039: The more I explored, the more I fell in love with the process. Through editing, design, and color grading, I discovered how small creative decisions could change the way a story feels.
texts.t043: My first client saw a design they liked and asked me to recreate it. That was the first time I was paid for my work — and the moment my career began.
texts.t044: A SMALL BEGINNING. A BIG TURNING POINT.
texts.t046: What began as something I did for myself grew into a full-time creative career. That same curiosity still shapes my work: I keep exploring, refining, and looking for the story inside every idea.
texts.t052: I see tools as a starting point. The real work is in shaping an idea into a storytelling art piece — using composition, editing, and color to create a feeling and hold the viewer’s attention.
texts.t057: WHAT THAT MEANS FOR YOUR WORK
texts.t064: Start with the message, the audience, and what you want them to feel. Give every creative choice a purpose.
texts.t068: Turn scattered ideas and unorganized designs into a clear visual direction, with rhythm, hierarchy, and intention.
texts.t072: Refine the edit, the details, and the color until everything works together as one polished, memorable piece.
texts.t079: My mission is to help creators and brands turn raw, unorganized designs into polished visual stories that connect with people and help grow their audience.

services.title: Brand Identity Design
services.description: A visual identity that feels unmistakably you. Distinctive logos, thoughtful color palettes, and typography that give your brand a consistent voice.

services.title: Graphic & Social Design
services.description: Scroll-stopping visuals with a clear message. Cohesive social graphics, digital creatives, and print layouts that bring your ideas into focus.

services.title: Web Design & Development
services.kicker: FROM FIRST IDEA TO FINAL PIXEL
services.description: A considered design, beautifully brought to life. Responsive websites that combine a strong visual identity with clear navigation and thoughtful interactions.

services.title: Website Redesign & Refresh
services.kicker: GIVE YOUR WEBSITE A NEW CHAPTER
services.description: A fresh perspective for your existing website. Refined layouts, stronger visual consistency, and a smoother experience across desktop and mobile.

awards.title: Visual Storytelling Award
awards.description: A sample recognition for bringing a brand’s personality to life through a thoughtful visual story.
awards.meaning: A reminder that strong design can do more than look good — it can make an idea feel meaningful.

awards.title: Digital Experience Distinction
awards.description: A sample recognition for a considered website experience, pairing clear navigation with expressive design.
awards.meaning: Celebrating the balance between how a website looks, how it works, and how it feels to use.

awards.title: Emerging Creative Recognition
awards.description: A sample achievement celebrating curiosity, experimentation, and the development of a distinctive creative voice.
awards.meaning: A place to recognize the small steps and thoughtful experiments that build a creative practice.

awards.title: Design Craft Commendation
awards.description: A sample commendation for attention to composition, purposeful color, and a cohesive finish.
awards.meaning: Because the quiet details are often what make a piece of work feel complete.

projects.title: The art of slowing down
projects.description: Story-led editing, thoughtful pacing, and warm visual storytelling.
projects.detail: A lifestyle film concept shaped with a strong opening, considered scene transitions, natural sound beds, and a warm, cohesive finish.

projects.title: Beyond the city
projects.description: A documentary-style edit built around narrative and atmosphere.
projects.detail: A documentary concept exploring city life through purposeful sequencing, interview pacing, ambient sound, and subtle motion typography.

projects.title: Inside the creative process
projects.description: A clean talking-head edit with engaging supporting visuals.
projects.detail: An educational video concept with a concise narrative, contextual B-roll, clear chapter structure, and restrained graphic accents.

projects.title: Somewhere, off the map
projects.description: Cinematic travel editing with a sense of place and discovery.
projects.detail: A travel film concept combining scenic sequences, rhythm-driven cuts, atmosphere, and an intentional beginning-to-end story arc.

projects.title: Everyday, elevated
projects.description: A product reel with rhythmic cuts and polished text treatments.
projects.detail: A vertical product reel concept using tight pacing, tactile detail shots, beat-matched cuts, and concise on-screen messaging.

projects.title: A moment in motion
projects.description: A travel reel shaped through quick transitions and visual rhythm.
projects.detail: A short travel concept built around a memorable hook, energetic scene selection, seamless match cuts, and a satisfying loop.

projects.title: Made to stand out
projects.description: An expressive social edit with punchy captions and bold pacing.
projects.detail: A creator reel concept pairing readable captions, purposeful punch-ins, sound accents, and a clean final call to action.

projects.title: The little details
projects.description: A lifestyle reel with soft transitions and a refined finish.
projects.detail: A lifestyle short concept focusing on close-up details, gentle speed changes, soft transitions, and warm, consistent color.

projects.title: Golden hour, reimagined
projects.description: Warm highlight shaping and balanced, cinematic skin tones.
projects.detail: A color concept exploring warm highlights, controlled contrast, natural skin-tone separation, and a gentle film-inspired finish. The placeholder image is an illustrative mood board.

projects.title: After dark
projects.description: Cool shadows and rich contrast for an atmospheric night look.
projects.detail: A night-grade concept with a cool shadow palette, intentional color separation, balanced highlights, and atmospheric sound layers.

projects.title: The sound of stillness
projects.description: Layered ambience and detailed sound design that support the story.
projects.detail: A sound design concept combining environmental ambience, carefully placed Foley, smooth dialogue beds, and dynamic balance. This image is a visual placeholder, not playable audio.

projects.title: A different kind of mood
projects.description: A cohesive color treatment with a carefully balanced sound mix.
projects.detail: A finishing concept unifying shot-to-shot color, selective saturation, music transitions, and a detailed, comfortable sound mix.

featured.title: Olea — rooted in simplicity
featured.description: A botanical skincare identity concept with an earthy palette, expressive wordmark, and understated packaging.

featured.title: Orbit — a different perspective
featured.description: A digital studio website concept with confident typography, a cool electric palette, and a clear hierarchy.

featured.title: Form & Feeling — creative culture
featured.description: An editorial concept exploring expressive typography and sculptural imagery.

featured.title: Volta — a fresh kind of energy
featured.description: A beverage packaging concept with a punchy orange palette, oversized type, and a memorable shelf presence.
